benchmarks.name: The Token Games Elo (10-model puzzle-duel tournament)

benchmarks.name: LAMBADA (OpenAI version), last-word accuracy
benchmarks.description: Zero-shot last-word prediction accuracy on the 5,153-passage OpenAI-detokenised LAMBADA test file used by GPT-2/GPT-3 and the EleutherAI harness (task 'lambada' in harness v0, later 'lambada_openai'). Not the original LAMBADA 'standard' split and not perplexity.
